dex.text: A heap of wet seaweed that hauls itself up the beach after a gale, shedding crabs. Farmers' carts used to queue for it. It has never understood why, and is a little flattered.
dex.fact: Vraic is the Jersey and Guernsey word for seaweed. Islanders gathered it from the shore, often after storms, to spread on their fields and to burn, and it is traditionally used to fertilise the Jersey Royal potato.
